_comment: Merge the 'hooks' key below into ~/.claude/settings.json.
These are the ONLY thing that writes state -- without them every pane
renders idle forever, because the tmux side only reads.
TMUX_COCKPIT_DIR is exported by cockpit.tmux; the fallback is the
documented install path, so the commands work either way.
Deliberately NOT wired:
SubagentStop  -> running cleared a failed subagent's error, so a run that
FAILED finished green. The next PostToolUse restores
running anyway, so the hook only destroyed information.
TaskCompleted -> fires mid-turn per task-list item, flashing green while
the agent keeps working. Stop already covers turn ends.
PreCompact    -> no pane state to report.
TeammateIdle -> wake: a teammate going idle messages its lead, and that
message wakes an idle lead with no hook of its own, so the pane sat on
green `done` until the lead's first tool call. wake flips done -> running
and leaves a blocked or errored lead alone.
PreToolUse fires BEFORE the permission decision, so it cannot clear a
needs-input flag raised by the prompt that follows it. PostToolUse is what
clears the red, once the approved tool has run.
Stop runs a second command, review-gate: it flags a finished pane whose
diff is unreviewed (◆) and hands a queued review to the agent as Stop hook
feedback (additionalContext on stdout). Its own timeout is 5 s; it never
blocks a turn otherwise.
WorktreeCreate -> worktree-create: claude --worktree <name> and EnterWorktree
put the tree under ~/.cache/cockpit-wt/<name> (branch <name>) instead of
.claude/worktrees/, and the session's cwd moves there, so prefix r, ◆, the
fleet and the status line all read the tree the agent works in (issue #3).
Creating through the hook does not prompt; entering an outside path by
hand does. Not with --worktree --tmux together: that skips the hook.
WorktreeRemove -> worktree-remove: claude deletes a git worktree itself
and then runs this with its cwd inside the deleted directory, so the
branch is found through the <tree>.repo sidecar worktree-create wrote.
A clean tree on a merged branch goes; a dirty tree or unmerged commits
stay, as claude does. claude -p never cleans up worktrees (docs), so a
subagent run under -p leaves its tree and slug branch behind.
_statusline_comment: Optional, and NOT part of the 'hooks' merge above: a statusLine that
reports context fill so scripts/agent-context can record it in
@panestate_ctx, for the tab-suffix example in examples/tmux.conf.
A statusLine REPLACES whatever statusLine you already have configured --
there is only ever one -- so this is commented out rather than wired in.
To use it, add a top-level 'statusLine' key to ~/.claude/settings.json:
Requires jq. Silently prints '<model> · ctx NN%' and does nothing to the
pane on any input it cannot parse -- see scripts/agent-context.
